number.sorted: Sort the result from small to large
number.nothingLeft: Every number in the range was left out, so there is nothing to draw.
number.tooFewForUnique: There are not enough numbers left in the range for a draw without repeats.
number.uniqueNeedsWholeNumbers: A draw without repeats only works with whole numbers. Set the decimal places back to 0.
